name: fuzzyclock
description: FuzzyClock — a fuzzy-time desktop overlay with a live stats panel, rendered as SVG
author: Alex Tabisz <alex@tabisz.org>

scripts.build: bun run build:main && bun run build:preload && bun run build:renderer && bun run build:assets
scripts.build:main: bun build src/main/main.ts --outfile dist/main.js --target node --external electron
scripts.build:preload: bun build src/preload.ts --outfile dist/preload.cjs --format cjs --target node --external electron
